name: normalize
description: Rewrite a rambling prompt into a compact engineering prompt. Works on any model, including small and cheap ones. English, Ukrainian, Russian.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite a rambling prompt into a compact engineering prompt
interface.longDescription: Turns a casual, rambling prompt into a compact engineering prompt: goal, a checkable "must be true" list and a "how to work" list. Keeps every requirement and invents none. Works on any model, including small and cheap ones. Answers in English, Ukrainian or Russian. Text only: it never runs the prompt.
